events.title: feat(uptime): Create uptime monitors through the detectors endpoint
events.excerpt: `create_uptime_monitor` posted to the legacy `POST /projects/{org}/{project}/uptime/` endpoint. That endpoint goes through `create_uptime_detector`, which never sets `Detector.created_by_id`. As a result, every uptime monitor an agent creates through the MCP has no creator. events.title: fix(get-doc): Say where an off-site redirect goes and that stale search results fail
events.excerpt: `search_docs` keeps returning docs pages that moved or were removed (getsentry/toolkit#2491). `get_doc` then fails on them, and its error tells the agent to run `search_docs` again. The agent gets the same path back and loops. Two message changes in `get_doc`: - A redirect off the docs hosts now names its target.
